title: FREE REQUEST Looking for Team Members (Chrono Star)

posts.author: Scratchblade
posts.body:
What's Chrono Star?
Hello, I'm Scratchblade, lead developer on Chrono Star. Inspired by classics like Final Fantasy IV and Chrono Trigger (hence the resemblance in naming) This game is being made on RPG Maker MZ. After your father, Gareth, was betrayed by King Lorik of Cardiff, you will set out on a journey across sprawling landscapes, filled with towns and dungeons. After you acquire the Spaceship, you can use it to explore the medieval fantasy past of the world, and its post-apocalyptic retro sci-fi future. Meet memorable characters across time, fight in balanced enemy encounters, and experience a compelling narrative both past and future. The actions you do in the past will affect the future, whether it be stealing from a shopkeeper in the past causing a massively successful industry in the future to never exist at all, or teaching a town how to save themselves from a plauge that will make a lineage of scientists that survive well into the future, Chrono Star is a beautiful jrpg experience.
Roles Needed:
Pixel Artist (Mainly character designs, bonus if can do tileset art)
8-bit Music Composer (Like those on the NES)
My Role(s)/Position(s):
Coding, mapping, eventing, and story writing, though anyone at the team can have story ideas
